description: This file defines a PHP trait 'CipherBuilderTrait' within the AWS SDK that provides methods related to cipher identification and construction, specifically for encrypting and decrypting data using different cipher modes.

methods.name: getCipherOpenSslName
methods.description: Returns an OpenSSL cipher name based on the provided cipher name and key size, e.g., 'aes-256-cbc'.

methods.name: buildCipherMethod
methods.description: Constructs and returns a CipherMethod object configured with the provided cipher name, IV, and key size for encryption or decryption.

methods.name: getCipherFromAesName
methods.description: Performs a reverse lookup to get the cipher type (e.g., 'gcm' or 'cbc') from a given AES name, throwing an exception if unsupported.
